$comment: Single source of truth for DiliRun brand colours. Sampled from the uploaded hero art (suit #69B3E9, cape #122D7B, sky #4F96DA) so the in-game palette and the generated sprites can never drift apart.
name: DiliRun

fonts.display: ui-rounded, 'Baloo Da 2', 'Hind Siliguri', 'Trebuchet MS', system-ui, sans-serif
fonts.note: No webfonts are downloaded: these are optional local faces with safe fallbacks (Hind Siliguri / Baloo Da 2 give proper Bengali glyphs when the OS has them).
